entries.def:
ἔγγυος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ, 
[in LXX: Sir.29.15, 16 2Ma.10.28 * ;] 
a surety: Heb.7.22 (exx. from π., see MM, Exp., xi; cf. Cremer, 222).†
(AS)

ἐγγύς, adv., 
[in LXX chiefly for קָרוֹב ;] 
near; 
__1. of place: Jhn.19.20, 42; as prep. with genitive (M, Pr., 99), Luk.19.11, Jhn.3.23; 6.19, 23; 11.18, 54, Act.1.12; with dative, Act.9.38; 27.8; superl., ἔγγιστα, Mrk.6.36, WH, mg.; metaphorically, ֹοἱ ἐ., opposite to οἱ μακράν, Eph.2.17 ἐ. γίνεσθαι, Eph.2.13 ἐ. σου τὸ ῥῆμα, Rom.10.8 (LXX). 
__2. Of time: Mat.24.32; 26.18, Mrk.13.28, 29 Luk.21.30, 31 Jhn.2.13;…

ἐγγύτερος, see: ἐγγύς. 
ἐγγύς, adv., 
[in LXX chiefly for קָרוֹב ;] 
near; 
__1. of place: Jhn.19.20, 42; as prep. with genitive (M, Pr., 99), Luk.19.11, Jhn.3.23; 6.19, 23; 11.18, 54, Act.1.12; with dative, Act.9.38; 27.8; superl., ἔγγιστα, Mrk.6.36, WH, mg.; metaphorically, ֹοἱ ἐ., opposite to οἱ μακράν, Eph.2.17 ἐ. γίνεσθαι, Eph.2.13 ἐ. σου τὸ ῥῆμα, Rom.10.8 (LXX). 
__2. Of time: Mat.24.32; 26.18, Mrk.13.28, 29…

ἔγερσις, -εως, ἡ (ἐγείρω, -ομαι)), 
[in LXX: Jdg.7.19, Psa.138 (139)2 (קוּם), I Est.5.62 * ;] 
__1. a rousing (Plat.). 
__2. a rising (Ps, l.with): from death, Mat.27.53.
† (AS)

ἐνκάθετος (Rec. ἐγκ-), -αν 
(ἐγκαθίημι), [in LXX: Job.31.9 (אָרַב), Job.19.12 * ;] 
suborned to lie in wait, lying in wait: as subst., Luk.20.20.†
(AS)

ἐγκαίνια, see: ἐνκ- 
ἐνκαίνια (Rec. ἐγκ-), -ων, τά (ἐν, καινός), 
[in LXX for HSjrj, II Est.6.16, 17, Neh.12.27, Dan.3.2 (and cf. ἐγκαινισμός, Num.7.10, al., -ισις, Num.7.88) *;] 
dedication (anniversary of the cleansing of the Temple from the defilements of Antiochus Epiphanes) : Jhn.10.22.†
(AS)

ἐγκαινίζω, see: ἐνκ-.
ἐν-καινίζω (Rec. ἐγκ-, see: ἐν), 
[in LXX: (to renew) 1Sa.11.14, 2Ch.15.8, Psa.51.10 (Br-m pi.); (to dedicate) Deu.20.5, 2Ch.7.5 (-^jn); Isa.16.11; 41.1; 45.16 (aliter in Heb.), Si 33(36):6, 1Ma.4.36,54,57; 5.1, 2Ma.2.29 *;] 
1. to innovate (Eust.). 2. to renew (LXX ut supr.). 3. to initiate, inaugurate, dedicate (LXX ut supr.) : διαθήκην, Heb.9.18 ; ὁδόν, Heb.10.20 (Cremer, 323).†
(AS)

ἐγκαλέω, -ῶ, 
[in LXX for אמר, etc.; with dative, Zec.1.4 (קָרָא אֶל), Wis.12.12, Sir.46.19 ;] 
__1. to call in, demand. 
__2. to bring a charge against, accuse: with dative of person(s) (as in cl.), Act.19.38; 23.28; before κατά, with genitive of person(s), Rom.8.33. Pass., to be accused: with genitive of thing(s); στάσεως, Act.19.40 ὦν (perh. by attraction = ἅ), Act.26.2 before περί, with genitive of thing(s),…

ἐγκαταλείπω, 
[in LXX chiefly for עזב ;] 
__1. to leave behind: ἡμῖν σπέρμα, Rom.9.29 (LXX). 
__2. to abandon, desert, forsake: with accusative of person(s), Mat.27.46 (LXX), Mrk.15.34 (ib.), Act.2.27 (LXX) (WH, ἐνκ-), 2Ti.4.10, 16 Heb.13.5" (LXX) ; τ. ἐπισυναγωγήν (cf. MM, Exp., xi), Heb.10.25. Pass., Act.2.31 (WH, ἐνκ-), 2Co.4.9.
† (AS)
